[attribute-page]
=== `@page` Page (of Related Article)

Page number of a related journal article, which may be either the number of the journal page on which the article starts or a page range.

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<attribute-page,`@page`>> attribute can be used with the <<attribute-vol,`@vol`>>, <<attribute-issue,`@issue`>>, and <<attribute-journal-id,`@journal-id`>> attributes to identify the related article <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The page number on which a related article starts or the range of pages for a
                        related article. For example, the value may be a page number such as
                        “`1145`”, a page range such as
                        “`35-583`”, or a letter/number combination, such as
                        “`46a`” or “`iii`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
